findings.title: Plugin completion logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: The prior implementation explicitly called `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` and added `traceID` to the `Plugin Request Completed` log fields. That extraction was removed, while the new contextual middleware only stores endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes. As a result, these egress-completion logs can no longer be correlated with their distributed trace. Restore the explicit trace field or add it to the contextual attributes, and cover the trace-bearing request case with a test.

findings.title: TestLogger drops logs emitted through FromContext
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a fresh `TestLogger` with separate log storage. `LoggerMiddleware` now emits its completion event through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`, so a test that passes a `TestLogger` to the middleware and inspects that original logger will observe no log entries; the event is recorded on an unreachable temporary fake. Return the same fake or a derived fake that shares the underlying `Logs` storage so context-derived logs remain observable.
